blocks.text: This HP ProBook x360 11 G2 EE is the ultimate adaptable companion for students, mobile professionals, and anyone needing a reliable, convertible 2-in-1 device. With its durable build, lightning-fast SSD storage, and the efficiency of the Intel Core i5 processor, this laptop is designed to keep up with your busy life. Enjoy the flexibility of switching seamlessly between a traditional laptop, a presentation stand, a tablet, and a tent mode with its 360-degree hinge and vibrant 11.6" touch display.

items.label: Seamless Performance
items.value: Equipped with the efficient Intel Core i5-7Y54 CPU and 8GB of RAM, this laptop delivers smooth performance for browsing, document editing, and video conferencing without the need for a noisy fan.

items.label: Instant Boot-Up & Storage
items.value: The 128GB Solid State Drive (SSD) ensures near-instant boot times and fast file access, significantly enhancing productivity over traditional hard drives.

items: The durable hinge transforms the 11.6-inch Touchscreen Display into four distinct modes (Laptop, Tent, Stand, and Tablet), offering unmatched flexibility for reading, writing, and presenting.
As an "Education Edition" (EE) model, the ProBook x360 features an extra-durable design, reinforced ports, and spill resistance—perfect for on-the-go reliability.
Professionally inspected, tested, and cleaned by qualified suppliers to work and look like new. Comes backed by the standard Amazon Renewed Guarantee.
